name: Streamer
description: Twitch/YouTube stream VODs with a facecam. Facecam on top, gameplay below.
highlight_criteria: Big streamer reactions (screaming, laughing, shock), chat-driven moments, donations or raids that cause a reaction, funny conversations, hot takes, rage and wins. Prefer moments where both the face reaction and what caused it are visible. Use chat spikes as strong evidence, but remember chat reacts 5 to 20 seconds after the moment itself.
